evidence.title: CSS Variables Editor - AI Browser Extension for managing colors in CSS Variables

name: CSS Variables Editor
summary: Chrome DevTools extension for viewing, editing and AI-generating the color CSS variables of any web page.
description: A DevTools pane that lists every global CSS variable holding a color (hex, HSL or OKLCH) and edits it with a picker, channel sliders or Tailwind's palette, applying changes to the page in real time. It adds WCAG contrast checks, swatch views and semantic color descriptions for shadcn/ui and daisyUI, AI palette generation with your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key, and exports of the changed variables.
contains: browser extension with a DevTools pane
lists global color CSS variables (hex, HSL, OKLCH)
color edits update the live page in real time
shadcn/ui and daisyUI support with swatches and semantic color descriptions
AI palette generation using your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key
